Messages.Author: rojom...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Just to be sure... as it was stated with Maris Streck, Gualtiero may
burn blood multiple times each action/combat to increase
stealth/damage/blood burning. Is this correct?

Using this ability with Dead Hand or Breath of Thanatos can make any
low capacity Giovanni the worst of your nightmares...

Gualtiero Ghiberti
7-cap Giovanni, group 4
cel pot tha DOM NEC
Independent: Once each turn when another Giovanni announces an action
or strike that requires Necromancy, Gualtiero may burn a blood to
increase the stealth of that action or the damage done or blood burned
by that action or strike by 1 (even if stealth is not yet needed).

The reason that Maris has an "issue" is that:

- she doesn't restrict how many times she can do it (with text like, you
know, "once each turn")
- she doesn't use the "During X, do Y" template which implicitly
restricts it to once

>if the "burn 'a' blood" had been "burn

The use of "one" would make no different to Maris. She'd burn one
blood. Then, because she has absolutely nothing restricting her, she'd
do it again.
